for: Task Card states that the example data does not reach: a single-action card with its ask and why, and a card whose due time has passed
rules: Test-only: loaded only by the build's test mode with fixtures=card-states.
Each fixture is one taskCards entry in the example data's shape, on an existing Lane.

fixtures.fixture: S-1 single-action card with its ask, why, undo and no-answer line
expect: Approve and Reject answer it, with an optional note.
The no-answer line reads 'If no answer by Wed 5 PM: nothing changes.'
The ask names what to approve and says how to undo it.

card.title: Approve the Appearance wording
card.about: The words for the three Appearance choices in Settings.
card.context:
Settings now has Appearance.
The three choices are System, Light and Dark.
Only the words are still open.
card.ascii:
Settings > Appearance
 ------------------------------------------
 System   follows the device
 Light    always light
 Dark     always dark
card.pick_why: The words match your notes from Monday.
card.skip: If no answer by due: nothing changes.
card.undo: Ask Alba to put the old words back; nothing else changes.

fixtures.fixture: S-2 two-way card past its due time
expect: The no-answer line says what happened and that he can still answer.

card.title: Ship the Search sheet today?
card.about: The new Search sheet, built and checked.
card.context:
The sheet shows five rows per group.
It passed all three checks.
Three tasks wait on it.
card.ascii:
Search sheet, phone
 ------------------------------------------
 Chats        5 rows    See all
 Task Cards   5 rows    See all
 Projects     2 rows
 Lanes        1 row

options.label: A. Ship it today
options.does: Turns the new sheet on for everyone.
options.undo: Turn the sheet off in Settings.
cons: Nobody has used it for a day.
options.why: All checks pass and three tasks wait on it.

options.label: B. Hold a day
options.does: Keeps the old sheet one more day.
cons: The waiting tasks lose a day.

card.pick_why: All checks pass, and three tasks wait on it.
card.skip: If no answer by due: Alba holds it and asks again Wednesday.
